di antara Pangkalan Sultan Abdul Halim dan Pangkalan Raja Tun Uda hendaklah

membayar tambang pada kadar yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

PENANG PORT COMMISSION ACT 1955

PENANG PORT COMMISSION (SCALE OF RATES OF FERRY SERVICE BETWEEN

PANGKALAN SULTAN ABDUL HALIM AND PANGKALAN RAJA TUN UDA)

BY-LAWS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 32(3) and sections 34, 66 and 67

of the Penang Port Commission Act 1955 [Act 140], the Commission, with the approval of

the Minister, makes the following by-laws:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These by-laws may be cited as the Penang Port Commission

(Scale of Rates of Ferry Service between Pangkalan Sultan Abdul Halim

and Pangkalan Raja Tun Uda) By-laws 2025.

(2) These By-laws come into operation on 15 August 2025.

Rates of ferry service

2. Any passenger or vehicle using the ferry services between Pangkalan Sultan Abdul

Halim and Pangkalan Raja Tun Uda shall pay the fare at the rates as specified

in the Schedule.
